correctness.rationale: At a Hermite spectrogram zero, the Wirtinger derivatives are independent Gaussians of variances n+1 and n and independent of the field value. Real Jacobian singular values equal U+V and |U−V|; Kac–Rice Palm weighting is |U²−V²|. The resulting t=V/U density is 4a²b² t|1−t²|/[E(b+a t²)^3] on t>0, with E=(a²+b²)/(a+b). Integration with q=(k−1)/(k+1) produces the stated antiderivative, the sharp 32a²b²/[(a²+b²)(a+b)²] tail coefficient, the moment threshold r=2 and the universal high-order survival 4k²/(k²+1)². The embedded checker tests normalizations, closed integrals, tails and limits, but the proof handles all orders and thresholds.

A complete local marked distribution and its universal high-order limit are natural quantitative invariants relevant to winding-number zero localization; these are not simply restatements of the known one-point intensity.
